title: Travis Lenkner discusses law firm economics on the Beyond Billables podcast
summary: Travis Lenkner discusses law firm economics on the Beyond Billables podcast. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Burford Capital Chief Operating Officer[Travis Lenkner](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/travis-lenkner/) appears on the ** Beyond Billables podcast to discuss how traditional law firm partnership structures can limit long-term investment in talent, technology and growth. Lenkner explores the evolution of legal finance beyond single-case funding, the growing interest in external investment in law firms and how Burford's approach differs from conventional private equity. He also discusses Burford's[investment in Kindleworth](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/news-press-releases/burford-capital-makes-strategic-investment-in-kindleworth-to-back-the-launch-and-expansion-of-next-generation-law-firms/) and the potential for AI to transform the legal sector.


Listen[here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BGTC_mnFWew) or below.
